name: blyx-weaver
description: Lay out equal-width tiles on small or large viewports, distribute leftover pixels and map pointer coordinates back to an item.

steps.title: Run the Weaver example
steps.description:

[Open the documentation](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/weaver)
